title: Daily Water Usage and Fixture Breakdown
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume / Flo / HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watermeter:flow
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(volume_l) as litres by fixture _time
| stats avg(litres) as avg_daily by fixture
| sort - avg_daily
description: Breaks your daily water use down by fixture so you can see whether the shower, garden, or laundry drives the bill.
value: Knowing which fixture uses the most water is the first step to cutting the bill, and it is usually a surprise.
implementation: Ingest per-fixture or disaggregated flow; schedule daily and rank fixtures by average usage.
visualization: Bar chart of average daily water use by fixture.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which taps and appliances use the most water at home, which is usually surprising.
